Baptised at Broadwindsor, Dorset, on 1 January 1667, son of Mathew Hutchins, and buried there on 17 September 1727
as "Hugh Senior". Children baptised to him at Broadwindsor include Susanna (1702) and William (1704) ,
and the register names the mother of his son Benjamin as Susanna.
The family book makes him the father of Thomas, who went to Salem, and the register bears it out:
"Thomas Huchens", son of Hugh, was baptised at Broadwindsor on 15 November 1693,
between a Hugh in 1691 and Benjamin in 1695.
Of Stoke-under-Ham, Somerset. The Broadwindsor register has a Hugh Hutchins marrying Mary Knight on 18 October 1712,
too late for her to be the mother of Thomas, born 1693.
She was probably the wife of Hugh the younger, baptised 1691, or Hugh senior's second wife.
The tree's death for her, 17 September 1727, is the day Hugh senior was buried,
and no burial of hers has been found.
